ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-3,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 4-I in the area bound by:

      A line 192 feet east of and parallel to South Rockwell Street; the alley next north of and
      parallel to West 21st Street; a line 312 feet east of and parallel to South Rockwell Street;
      and West 21st Street,

to those of a C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            ____________________________
                                                            Byron Sigcho-Lopez
                                                            Alderman, 25th Ward




Common Address:
2508 W. 21st Street
